flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

opportunities.point: Management sticks to its guidance of INR3,500 crores for the current year.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "See, basically, the guidance as of now, we are sticking to the guidance of INR3,500 crores." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: The company expects around 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60% to 70% growth in terms of value for the coming year.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "So this year, i.e current coming year, it will be around 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60%-70% growth in terms of value" (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Operations have successfully commenced at the new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Coming to the quarter, Q1 FY27 was an important period for the company, particularly from an operational perspective, with the successful commencement of operations at our new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: The upcoming Jaipur facility will further strengthen the company's manufacturing footprint.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Alongside this, the upcoming Jaipur facility will further strengthen our manufacturing footprint and support our ability to address the growing demand across markets." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Expectations baked into the price are low, so little has to go right.
Rising institutional interest can keep supporting the price.
opportunities.evidence: POSITIVE MONEY FLOW - institutional holding change 0.36 pp

opportunities.point: The outlook for organized jewellery continues to remain constructive, supported by strong wedding and occasion-led demand.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "From an industry perspective, the outlook for the organized jewellery continues to remain constructive. India's jewellery market is supported by strong wedding and occasion-led demand, rising disposable incomes, and an increasable preference for organized and..." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Management remains very bullish on the long-term fundamentals of gold.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "So the long-term, our vision towards the gold is very, very bullish. The long-term fundamentals remain very strong." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Current capacity utilization for the Mumbai existing facility is 75%.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "It's currently right now 75%." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: The total installed capacity on completion is 7,900 kg per annum.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "(Total capacity on completion: 7,900 kg pa)" (concall ppt - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: The Marol factory is expected to start in a month or so.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "So see, our new factory is almost ready, which is going to be like in a month or so for Marol factory, and I guess Jaipur factory should be starting by around September, October now." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Promoter selling is a warning about insider conviction.
Both foreign and domestic institutions have been reducing.
threats.evidence: FII -0.46 pp, DII -2.37 pp over the recent quarters

threats.point: The stock has drawn down sharply in the past.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
The incorporation timeline for the Dubai subsidiary has been extended to June '26 due to geopolitical issues and wars.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "So due to all these wars and all, it is extended for a couple of months more ahead now because the situation, geopolitical things are not good." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

swot.verdict: Opportunities dominate the evidence (S23/W9/O29/T12), led by 'Buying below the model's intrinsic value leaves room for a re-rating', so the case leans on things that are not in the reported numbers yet.
